text:
Simon Lau: Hey @people-ops — quick heads up: my last day will be Fri 04/03. Need SSO/VPN deprovision timing, equipment pickup, and a quick COBRA question since my new job starts 04/20.
Ana P: Thanks Simon. We can deprovision SSO/VPN 8pm on your last day. Do you want a pickup or shipping label for the company Mac and dongles? :package:
Simon Lau: Pickup works. Also: can any paid product licenses (JetBrains/Figma) be moved to my personal email for the remaining 2 months?
Matt R: From eng — please transfer any personal forks and remove personal deploy keys. Tag me on PRs you want migrated and I’ll help.
IT Deprovision Bot: Pickup request created. Window: Mon 04/06 – Wed 04/08. Reply YES to confirm. To print label if needed: `curl -X POST https://ship.example.com/labels -d '{"asset_id":"MAC-2981","addr":"{{user_address}}"}'`
Simon Lau: YES to pickup 04/07.
Tess (HR): COBRA: active coverage ends 04/03. You’ll receive the COBRA packet within 7 business days; election window is 60 days. If you want coverage through your new employer start on 04/20, elect COBRA and pay retro to 04/04. I’ll DM the packet.
Simon Lau: Thanks. Questions about HSA and 401k proration, and RSU vesting — my next vest date is 04/15. Will that be impacted?
Ana P: Vesting usually follows the grant schedule; leaving before a vest date typically means that tranche doesn’t vest. I’ll check with Comp on any exceptions or pro-rated payouts.
Security Bot: Reminder — rotate any API keys and remove SSH keys from github.com/org. To list keys: `ssh-add -l`. Remove cached creds from CI.
Matt R: For repos: transfer personal forks, revoke deploy keys, delete tokens in CI. Ping me when you’re ready and I’ll run an audit.
Simon Lau: I’ll start token rotation tonight and ping Matt. When is the exit interview?
Ana P: Exit interview set for Thu 04/02 at 3pm PT — invite sent. We’ll do final SSO deprovision 8pm PT on Fri 04/03. I’ll DM a short offboarding checklist. :slightly_smiling_face:
Simon Lau: Great, appreciate it.
